Great Landslides today occurred in the potash mines of Vienenburg, near Brunswick. Many of the mines collapsed. Big craters forming in the ground, some of them 120 feet in diameter. In one case a railway embankment disappeared completely. A mine manager and three companions had a narrow escape when a car fell down into the crater. They extricated themselves with difficulty. - • Rumania, Denmark and Norway have ordered airplanes for training army aviators.
